rationale: C15 plausibly supplied the child’s compact congratulatory appointment-letter template: an opening expressing delight that the recipient accepted an important post, followed by a description of the relevant policy work and the recipient’s opportunity to advance it. The shared progression and close wording are more concrete than generic appointment correspondence. C08 and C03 contain related willingness/service language, but their structures and purposes are less closely aligned.

shared_material.child_excerpt: I am indeed delighted to learn that you have accepted the highly important assignment of heading the Agricultural Division
shared_material.parent_excerpt: I am delighted to learn that you have agreed to serve as a member of the Committee on Education Beyond the High School
shared_material.explanation: Both open with the distinctive formula “I am delighted to learn that you have” followed by the recipient’s acceptance of a specific assignment.

shared_material.child_excerpt: you have in your new assignment a rich opportunity to carry forward this significant work
shared_material.parent_excerpt: you can through the work of this Committee perform a great service to the Nation
shared_material.explanation: Both pivot from acceptance of the position to the useful work the recipient can perform through that appointment.

shared_material.child_excerpt: With your firsthand knowledge of agricultural conditions and of Administration accomplishments in this field
shared_material.parent_excerpt: In augmenting public awareness ... and in determining how better to assure that students will have those facilities available
shared_material.explanation: Each briefly identifies the substantive field and explains why service in the new position can advance an established policy objective.
